titleStmt.title: Archival Sample Charter (1584) - OMNI-Audit Test Document

body.p: In yethe name of God, Amen. Note: Witnessed by Thomas Smith, Bailiff Thif fcripture wrayten in ye yeare of oure Lorde 1584 and confirmed by the court witneffeth that John de la Croft & hif heyres shall paye V shillingf yearely. Paid in full on Michaelmas
